## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage3 sweep identified a parameter set that achieves high wide_pnl by tightening the stop (to 35% loss limit) and setting a very high TP1 target (150%), combined with other adjustments. The hypothesis is that this captures large moves while limiting losses, but we observe poor performance on J's winner days, suggesting the edge may not be robust or may be overfit to non-J periods.

## Mechanism

Enter on the shotgun_scalper_stage3 signal (details not provided in input) with:
- TP1 at +150% of entry premium (tp_premium_pct=1.5)
- Stop-loss at -35% of entry premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)
- Time stop of 15 minutes after entry (time_stop_min=15)
- Strike offset of 2 (likely OTM-2 or ITM-2, baseline unknown)
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% favorable move (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5)
- Volume ratio threshold of 1.0 for entry filter (vol_ratio_threshold=1.0)
Exit occurs on TP1 hit, stop-loss hit, time stop, or chandelier_arm profit-lock activation.
